history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: thin provisional record. map.geocode resolves this row to 'Siva Subrahmanya Swamy Temple, NH-30, Bhadrachalam, Burgampahad 507111' (17.66513, 80.88918), ~2.4 km east of the Bhadrachalam Rama temple; ishtadevata.com lists it as a Murugan temple at Bhadrachalam. No published history, hours, or festivals were found, and whether it is a distinct temple or a shrine within another complex is unverified. Not to be confused with the identically named Siva Subramanya Swami Temple in Chennai (Saidapet). CSV town Bhadrachalam is correct.

name: Siva Subrahmanya Swamy Temple (Bhadrachalam)
town_description: Bhadrachalam is a temple town in Bhadradri Kothagudem district, Telangana, on the northern bank of the Godavari, about 115 km from Khammam and 325 km east of Hyderabad. It is dominated by the famous Sita Ramachandraswamy Temple on Bhadragiri hill.
